issue.title: test_block_spread_bracket_top_aligns flakes in isolation on a scroll-settle wait_for timeout

task_type_fields.evidence: Reproduced by sase-1b2.land on master c78eb3805: 1 failure in 6 isolated serial runs (`-p no:randomly`, the failing run took 7.07s against about 2s for passes), which matches a scroll-settle wait_for timeout. sase-1b2.11 note #3 (epic sase-1b2) first saw it fail in about 1 of 3 isolated runs on the clean base tree with a 5s scroll-settle wait_for timeout, unrelated to the card-document-view extraction. It is a sibling of sase-1a7 (test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top), which also fails in isolation with the same scroll-settle timeout. The two may share a root cause in how deck pilots wait for the anchor scroll to settle.
